name: TP SL Trailing
summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that manages existing positions by dynamically adjusting stop loss and take profit levels based on configurable trailing parameters. It does not open its own trades but instead monitors and modifies open positions to protect profits and limit losses. The tool provides automated trailing stop and take profit management for manual or other EA-placed orders.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个跟踪止损工具，通过基于可配置的跟踪参数动态调整止损和止盈水平来管理现有仓位。它不自行开仓交易，而是监控和修改已有仓位以保护利润和限制亏损。该工具为手动或其他EA下单的订单提供自动化的跟踪止损和止盈管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA属于工具类辅助程序，不具备自主开仓策略。其核心功能是对已有持仓执行跟踪止损和跟踪止盈操作，当价格朝有利方向移动时，止损会随之移动以锁定浮盈。出场条件完全依赖于跟踪止损和止盈的触发，没有独立的信号判断逻辑。仓位管理方面，该工具不涉及开仓手数计算，仅对已有仓位进行止损止盈的修改操作。资金管理依赖于用户设置的跟踪参数，如跟踪距离和激活点数等。整体而言，该工具是一个纯辅助性质的仓位管理器，需要配合其他交易策略使用。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a utility-type assistant program that does not possess its own trade entry strategy. Its core function is to execute trailing stop and trailing take profit operations on existing positions, moving the stop loss to lock in floating profits when price moves favorably. Exit conditions rely entirely on trailing stop and take profit triggers, with no independent signal generation logic. Regarding position sizing, the tool does not involve lot size calculation for new entries and only modifies stop loss and take profit of existing positions. Money management depends on user-configured trailing parameters such as trailing distance and activation thresholds. Overall, this tool is a purely auxiliary position manager that must be combined with other trading strategies to be effective.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术号用于筛选特定订单
parameters.description_en: EA unique ID to distinguish orders across instances

pros: 自动跟踪止损止盈，减少人工盯盘压力
可配置参数灵活，适应不同交易风格和品种
作为辅助工具可与任何交易策略配合使用
有效锁定浮盈，防止盈利回吐
支持按魔术号筛选订单，不影响其他EA持仓
pros_en: Automates trailing stop and take profit management, reducing manual monitoring burden
Flexible configurable parameters adapt to different trading styles and instruments
Works as an auxiliary tool compatible with any trading strategy
Effectively locks in floating profits and prevents profit givebacks
Supports magic number filtering to avoid interfering with other EA positions
cons: 不自主开仓，完全依赖外部信号或其他EA入场
参数设置不当可能导致止损过紧被假突破扫出或过松失去保护意义
缺乏高级跟踪模式如分步跟踪或基于指标的动态跟踪
在剧烈波动行情中跟踪止损可能频繁触发增加滑点成本
没有可视化界面显示当前跟踪状态和持仓信息
cons_en: Does not open trades independently, fully dependent on external signals or other EAs for entry
Improper parameter settings may cause stops too tight getting stopped out by false breakouts or too loose losing protection effectiveness
Lacks advanced trailing modes such as step-based trailing or indicator-based dynamic trailing
Trailing stops may trigger frequently during volatile market conditions, increasing slippage costs
No visual interface to display current trailing status and position information
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态跟踪止损模式，使跟踪距离随波动率自适应调整
添加图形化面板显示当前持仓的跟踪状态和止损止盈水平
增加分步跟踪功能，在不同盈利阶段使用不同的跟踪参数
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic trailing stop mode to make trailing distance adapt to market volatility
Add a graphical panel to display current trailing status and stop loss/take profit levels for open positions
Implement stepped trailing functionality using different trailing parameters at various profit stages

risk_points: 参数设置为零时跟踪功能不生效，可能导致持仓无保护
高频修改止损可能在极端行情下因网络延迟导致修改失败
risk_points_en: Trailing function is inactive when parameters are set to zero, potentially leaving positions unprotected
High-frequency stop modifications may fail during extreme market conditions due to network latency
